application_credentials.description: Enable the [Google Docs API]({docs_api_url}) in your Google Cloud project. You can use the same OAuth client ID and secret as Google Sheets. In [Google Cloud credentials]({oauth_creds_url}), create a Web application OAuth client if needed and add `{redirect_uri}` as an authorized redirect URI.

abort.create_document_failure: Unable to create the document. Check that the Google Docs API is enabled in your Google Cloud project and try again.
abort.missing_configuration: Application credentials are missing. Add your OAuth client ID and secret.
abort.missing_scope: The required file permission was not granted. Start setup again and allow access to files used with this app.
abort.oauth_failed: Unable to obtain Google account authorization
abort.open_document_failure: Unable to open the existing document. Use the Google account that owns it and check that the document still exists and the Google Docs API is enabled.

create_entry.default: Successfully authenticated and document created at: {url}

reauth_confirm.description: Authorize your Google account again to reconnect the existing document. A new document will not be created.
reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Google Docs

append_failed.message: Failed to append text to the Google document

auth_failed.message: Google account authorization expired. Reauthenticate Google Docs in Settings > Devices & services.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to connect to Google. Try again later.

document_not_accessible.message: Unable to access the Google document. Check that it still exists, the account has permission, and the Google Docs API is enabled.

get_failed.message: Failed to read text from the Google document

append_text.name: Append text
append_text.description: Appends text to the first tab of the configured Google document.

config_entry.description: The document to append text to.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text to append exactly as supplied. Include a newline to separate paragraphs.
